anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: Schoone Oordt Country House: Historic Victorian Charm in Swellendam
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Nestled in the heart of historic Swellendam, Schoone Oordt Country House offers an exquisite blend of Victorian elegance and warm South African hospitality. This 5-star boutique hotel, celebrated for its tranquil atmosphere and personalized service, invites guests to unwind in luxurious rooms and suites. Enjoy gourmet breakfasts in the charming Conservatory, relax by the fire-lit gin bar, or explore the lush gardens. With its prime location, Schoone Oordt provides a perfect base for discovering Swellendam's rich heritage, antique shops, and acclaimed local restaurants, all within a short, scenic walk. Experience a truly authentic and serene escape.
